discoveredDefects.title: Broken transaction boundary due to missing tx argument and AsyncLocalStorage proxy disconnect
discoveredDefects.risk: Writes execute outside transaction context directly in pooled autocommit mode. If batch operation fails, prior records are already committed and rollback is ineffective.
discoveredDefects.remediationDetails: Intercepted db.transaction in client.ts proxy to wrap transactionFn with transactionStorage.run(innerTx). Bound tx directly in pricelistQuery.ts and catalogOperations.ts.

discoveredDefects.title: Cross-tenant mutation vulnerability and silent error swallowing in WhatsApp HitL Queue
discoveredDefects.risk: copilotHitlCards update filtered only by ID without organizationId; .catch(() => {}) silently masks database failure.
discoveredDefects.remediationDetails: Enforced multi-tenant isolation with and(eq(id), eq(organizationId)) and added structured error logging to console.error.

discoveredDefects.title: Production empty catch blocks in DICOM viewer launcher and Telegram webhook callback
discoveredDefects.risk: Filesystem and DB errors swallowed silently without observability.
discoveredDefects.remediationDetails: Replaced empty catch blocks with structured request.log.warn with operational context.

discoveredDefects.title: Unvalidated request.body as any in SanPiN autopilot routes
discoveredDefects.risk: Untyped payload injection bypassing runtime validation.
discoveredDefects.remediationDetails: Implemented strict Zod schemas (autofillShiftSchema, bactericidalAutopilotBodySchema, morningShiftBodySchema, eveningShiftBodySchema) and safe runtime parsing.

discoveredDefects.title: Synthetic fiscal document number generation (FD-) in production invoice endpoints
discoveredDefects.risk: Invoices return fake fiscal receipt numbers (FD-XXXX) synthesized from invoice ID instead of actual fiscal receipt numbers from payments table.
discoveredDefects.remediationDetails: Removed fake FD- string synthesizers. Added relational queries to payments table; returns genuine fiscalReceiptNumber or null if unfiscalized.
